title: laya_p request and response for POST /v1/systemone (R6 client, R7 server)

items.description: one item per candidate option; no energy numbers, no task id (R5 6.7, D3)

text.description: failure class, failure point, option, attempt, error message, last user turn, last two agent messages

calibration.description: temperature scaling id; uncalibrated responses are rejected by the client

description: Client rule: timeout 2 s from request send; any timeout, connection error, non 200, schema mismatch or missing option fails closed to beta_p and records the reason.
